name: string-instrument-tuner
title: String Instrument Tuner
summary: Chromatic microphone tuner with string presets, custom tunings, cents deviation, and reference tones.
features: Nine preset instrument families and arbitrary custom strings
Adjustable concert pitch and reference tone
limits: Microphone requires HTTPS or localhost and permission. Monophonic periodic signals about 24–1400 Hz; harmonics and noise can reduce accuracy.

name: blues-progression-atlas
title: Blues Progression Atlas
summary: Transpose classic blues forms, inspect chord tones, and audition a twelve-bar backing pattern.
features: Four original educational blues form charts
All twelve keys and chord-tone inspection
Synthesized backing playback and JSON export
limits: Educational harmonic templates; no copyrighted recordings or lyrics are bundled.

name: surfcoder-boombox
title: SurfCoder Boombox
summary: A virtual boombox for local audio queues and user-supplied radio streams, with spectrum meters.
features: Local audio queue and custom stream URLs
limits: Stream availability and formats depend on the provider. No stations or copyrighted tracks are bundled; stream requests go to the URL you choose.

name: polyrhythm-matrix
title: Polyrhythm Matrix
summary: Hear and visualize independent rhythmic cycles with tempo, subdivision, and accent control.
limits: Audio timing is subject to browser timer scheduling.

name: interval-ear-gym
title: Interval Ear Gym
summary: A randomized listening quiz with ascending, descending, and harmonic intervals and session scores.
limits: Training tones only. Playback starts after a user action.

name: chord-voicing-lab
title: Chord Voicing Lab
summary: Build and audition extended chords, inversions, and voice-leading between two harmonies.
features: Eight chord qualities in all keys
Sequence audition and JSON note export
limits: Close-position educational voicings; no automatic professional arrangement claims.

name: ambient-soundscape-mixer
title: Ambient Soundscape Mixer
summary: Mix synthesized surf, rain, wind, and drone layers locally with a sleep fade timer.
limits: Procedural noise is an approximation of natural sounds. No therapeutic claims.

name: audio-ab-loop-studio
title: Audio A–B Loop Studio
summary: Practice a selected section of a local recording with A–B markers, playback speed, and pitch preservation.
features: Local file playback and A–B markers
limits: Loop precision and pitch preservation depend on browser media implementation.

name: pocket-drum-foundry
title: Pocket Drum Foundry
summary: Program a sixteen-step synthesized drum groove with swing, per-voice levels, and pattern export.
limits: Browser timers can introduce jitter. No hardware drum samples are included.

name: spectrogram-waterfall
title: Spectrogram Waterfall
summary: Inspect microphone or local audio as a scrolling frequency heatmap with adjustable range.
features: Four FFT resolutions and range selection
limits: Microphone requires HTTPS/localhost and permission. This is a relative magnitude display, not a calibrated measurement instrument.

name: wav-loudness-auditor
title: WAV Loudness Auditor
summary: Measure PCM WAV peaks, RMS, clipping, DC offset, and crest factor with per-channel JSON reports.
features: Per-channel peak, RMS, crest factor and DC offset
limits: PCM16 uncompressed WAV only; RMS is not integrated LUFS and sample peaks are not intersample true peaks.
usage: Generate synthetic audio with `python examples/make_fixture.py`, then run `python app.py examples/demo.wav`. Supply your own PCM16 WAV path to measure it without modifying it.

name: midi-file-inspector
title: MIDI File Inspector
summary: Parse Standard MIDI Files, running status, tempo events, track names, and note counts.
features: Standard MIDI header and track parsing
Tempo, track names and note-event counts
limits: Reads Standard MIDI Files; reports ticks rather than claiming an exact elapsed duration across SMPTE/tempo maps.
usage: Run `cargo run -- examples/demo.mid`. The built executable also accepts any supported `.mid` file. Truncated chunks and malformed status bytes are rejected.

name: scale-fingering-planner
title: Scale Fingering Planner
summary: Map scale notes to any fretted string tuning and export positions as JSON or readable tablature.
features: Custom string tuning and fret range
Major, natural minor, minor pentatonic and blues scales
Pitch class, scale degree and MIDI position export
limits: Equal-tempered fret maps; does not infer optimal physical hand fingering or account for microtonal/fretless instruments.
usage: Example: `go run . --root 9 --scale blues --tuning 40,45,50,55,59,64 --frets 5`. Root 9 is A. Output lists each string/fret containing a scale tone.

name: sample-pack-cataloger
title: Sample Pack Cataloger
summary: Index WAV libraries in SQLite, detect duplicate audio files, and search by duration and sample rate.
limits: Uncompressed WAV formats supported by Python wave; duplicates mean identical files, not perceptually identical recordings. Missing files are retained until the index is rebuilt.
usage: Index: `python app.py /path/to/samples --db catalog.sqlite`. Search: `python app.py --db catalog.sqlite --search kick --minimum 0.2`. Scanning writes only the catalog, never audio files.

name: wav-channel-toolkit
title: WAV Channel Toolkit
summary: Split PCM16 stereo recordings into mono channels or reverse frames without corrupting channel order.
limits: PCM16 mono/stereo only; files are loaded into memory. Does not decode compressed audio or preserve ancillary RIFF metadata.
usage: Build, then run `./wav-toolkit left examples/demo.wav left.wav` or `./wav-toolkit reverse examples/demo.wav reversed.wav`. Existing output files are rejected.

name: impulse-response-forge
title: Impulse Response Forge
summary: Generate deterministic stereo delay impulse-response WAV files for convolution experiments.
limits: Synthetic sparse delay responses, not measured rooms. Twelve taps maximum; values are bounded to PCM range.
usage: Build and run `./impulse-forge room-ir.wav 125 0.65 2`. Import the output into a convolution processor. Choose a new output filename each time.

name: setlist-flow-planner
title: Setlist Flow Planner
summary: Order a setlist using tempo and tonal-distance costs, with fixed openers and a transition report.
limits: Greedy heuristic, not a globally optimal setlist. Key must be a circle-of-fifths index 0–11; major/minor mode and musical style are not inferred.
usage: Create a JSON array with `title`, `bpm`, and `key` (circle-of-fifths index, e.g. C=0, G=1, D=2). Run `dotnet run -- examples/songs.json`. The first input stays the opener.

name: lyrics-rhyme-notebook
title: Lyrics Rhyme Notebook
summary: Keep original lyric fragments in a local JSON notebook and search approximate suffix rhymes.
features: Atomic JSON save for new fragments
limits: English spelling suffix heuristic, not phonetic rhyme detection. Homophones and irregular pronunciations can be missed.
usage: Add: `ruby app.rb add "Your original line"`. Search: `ruby app.rb rhyme night`. Use `--file path.json` to choose a notebook. No copyrighted lyric corpus is bundled.

name: podcast-chapter-builder
title: Podcast Chapter Builder
summary: Convert timestamped chapter notes into validated Podcasting 2.0 chapter JSON.
limits: Plain timestamp/title TSV only. Output does not alter the audio file; redirect stdout to a new chapter JSON file.
setup:
- uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
usage: Create a TSV with `00:00<TAB>Introduction` and subsequent increasing timestamps. Run `java Main chapters.tsv > chapters.json`. Each chapter requires a nonblank title.

name: practice-session-composer
title: Practice Session Composer
summary: Allocate focused music-practice blocks using weighted priorities and export a timed Markdown plan.
limits: Planning tool only; does not listen to performance, assess technique, or prescribe physical exercise.
setup:
- uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.10.2'
usage: Edit `examples/priorities.tsv` with name TAB positive-weight rows. Run `gradle run --args="45 examples/priorities.tsv" --quiet`. Integer minutes are allocated with the largest-remainder method.
